_comment: Copy this file to customer-config.json and fill in all values before running cdk synth.
_platform_defaults_note: architecture, backend seed image URI/tag, etc. → launcher/cdk/platform_defaults.json
_ec2_instance_count_note: ec2_min_instances / ec2_desired_instances / ec2_max_instances control the ASG size for the handlers ECS EC2 cluster. Set min=1 to keep at least one instance warm.
_ec2_deploy_note: When compute_type is ec2, the synthesized template includes VpcId and SubnetIds CloudFormation parameters. The customer selects their default VPC (or any VPC) and subnets at stack deploy time — no VPC values needed here.
_lambda_deploy_note: Backend Lambdas are created by the app stack with a seed ECR image (updated by the releases OIDC pipeline). Handlers Lambda is created by the compute stack with inline seed code (updated by the handlers OIDC pipeline).
_extension_path_note: Sibling folder with installer/infra/cdk_extension.json. Synth emits extension resources in stack-b + extension-state.json (runtime vs inventory outputs) and copies extension blueprints into bootstrap/output/<env>/.
